agent_notes: Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy's exact self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to confirmed search and csauk.ac.in hosts.

The current official Programme Details PDF linked from the homepage/Students navigation lists 10 undergraduate, 19 postgraduate and 16 doctoral programmes (45 total) and was used for the 45 degree/doctoral courses below.

The official Academics navigation separately exposes a Post Graduate Diploma in Agri-Journalism and Science Communication page, supported by official 2023 rules and syllabus PDFs, but that diploma is omitted from the current 45-programme count; it is included below and makes the catalogue partial.

The official New Courses page links a 2021 NEP-2020 PDF containing 13 three/four-month short courses. No current admission or active-session evidence was found, so these potentially expired short-term offerings are excluded rather than asserted active; manual review is required.

The official location page confirms Kanpur and the contact page gives the Nawabganj, Kanpur address, but no official institution page reviewed explicitly names the district as Kanpur Nagar; district is therefore left null pending an official district-level statement.
